$comment: Cost/token PROJECTION for the PyJWT pilot in pilot_config.json. Every number here is either (a) MEASURED (a real character/word count of a real file this pass wrote) or (b) an ESTIMATE/PROJECTION derived from that measurement plus a disclosed heuristic and the real, dated price schedule in pilot_config.json. NOTHING here is a billed cost, an observed token count, an observed latency, or an observed retry rate -- those require an actual API call, which this pass did not make (see protocol.md#10). Consumed by console/panels/costUsage.js and console/panels/llmAttempts.js.

measured_inputs.evidence_packet_source: experiments/pilot_evidence_packet.md, the literal packet content between its two horizontal rules
measured_inputs.note: These character/word counts are real measurements of real files, not projections. Everything below this key is a projection built on top of them.

token_estimation_method.description: Anthropic does not publish an offline tokenizer for Claude; the real count requires either a live count_tokens API call (not made -- needs the same billable key) or an approximation. Two independent heuristics are cross-checked and both kept visible rather than collapsed into one falsely-precise number.
token_estimation_method.reconciliation: The two heuristics disagree by ~1.5x (878 vs 1320), expected because the packet is code-and-markdown-heavy, which token-izes less efficiently per word than plain prose. Point estimate uses their midpoint; range uses the low heuristic as the floor and 1.15x the high heuristic as a ceiling margin.

output_token_assumption.basis: The illustrative rule bundle shown in the evidence packet's own output-format example is ~90 tokens; a real generation covering both in-scope sites (rename_symbol + one replace_call, or an abstain entry for the harder site) plausibly runs 2-6x longer once the model restates fields, so a range is assumed rather than measured.
output_token_assumption.caveat: This is a bare assumption, not derived from the evidence packet's measured size. It is the single weakest number in this file and the first one a real pilot call should replace.

repair_feedback_assumption.basis: Phase 5 (repair/feedback.py) does not exist, so no real repair-feedback-packet size can be measured. Assumed as roughly one-quarter of the initial evidence packet's size (diagnostics for 1-2 failed sites, not the whole packet re-sent).

cost_projection_usd.price_schedule_used: pilot_config.json#price_schedule (Claude Haiku 4.5, fetched 2026-09-05: $1/$5 per MTok input/output, $1.25/$0.10 per MTok cache write/read)
cost_projection_usd.single_uncached_request_note: If only ONE request is ever sent (e.g. the initial generation succeeds and no repair is needed), no caching benefit is realized and this is the relevant number.
cost_projection_usd.full_5_request_trajectory_note: 1 initial request (cache write) + 4 repair rounds (cache read on the evidence-packet prefix + fresh repair-feedback tokens), covering all four registered repair budgets (1/2/3/5) from prefixes of one trajectory, per pilot_config.json's paired-prefix policy.
cost_projection_usd.two_replicate_pilot_worst_case_assumptio: High-end token estimate for every request, no repair round ever benefits from caching (treated as if freshly written each time), every trajectory runs the full 5 requests even if earlier rounds already passed.
cost_projection_usd.interpretation: Even the worst-case projection for the full registered PyJWT pilot (2 replicates, up to 5 requests each) is under 5 US cents. This is real evidence that a Haiku-4.5-based pilot is cheap enough that spend is not the binding constraint on running it -- API-key availability and authorization are.

not_estimated_at_all.latency_per_request: No basis exists for even a rough projection without an observed request; recorded as unknown, not zero or a guessed number.
not_estimated_at_all.retry_rate: Same -- no observed requests exist. pilot_config.json sets a retry CEILING (a cap chosen by policy), which is a different thing from a projected or measured retry RATE.
not_estimated_at_all.schema_validity_rate: Cannot be projected from pricing or packet size at all; this is exactly the outcome the real pilot exists to measure.
not_estimated_at_all.direct_arm_A_B_cost: Not estimated in this file. Arms A/B are repository-local direct-patching loops requiring an admitted development repository, which does not exist (Phase 6 has not started). Estimating their cost here would need to invent a fictitious repository interaction; instead this is named as a separate, larger, still-open cost item -- see protocol.md#10.
